title: Can Be Harmful
text: Can Be Harmful. I may have an allergy to whatever is in incense so I'm not knocking the company or the incense.  If you're looking for a strong smell, you will like these, plus you get so many for such a low price.  My husband lit one in the small condo we live in and I had come out of my bedroom into an area full of smoke.  I was immediately overcome but the scent and smoke.  I felt sick right away and have been nauseous for almost 24 hours now.  I started reading that incense smoke can be harmful.  I cannot comment on the scent as I have very little sense of smell.
